toolchain.notes: Train with the Xcode the app ships against. Verified against Xcode 27 RC (iPhoneOS27.0.sdk): options are -s/--source, -o/--output, -m/--training-mode {standard|extended}, --front|--upright|--all-angles (default --upright), --objects-to-avoid (repeatable), --checkpoint, --summary, --summary-fd, --csv-progress, --csv-fd.

assets._comment: EXAMPLE entry — fields show the required provenance shape. Real assets replace this; one entry per shipped .referenceobject revision.
assets.physical_binding: Example fixture panel — replace with the real mounted object this asset represents.

source_usdz.scale_validation: calipers on the physical panel; USDZ units are meters — compare bounding box before training

assets.license_provenance: Original scan of own equipment; no third-party content.
